title: Commercial Natural Gas Supply Terms: Renewal History and the Loyalty Credit Base
content:
**Clause.** The base credit of a Commercial Natural Gas Supply renewal loyalty credit (the renewal loyalty credit of the plan in force on the acceptance date) is carried into the loyalty credit according to the agreement's renewal history:

(a) when one or more renewal loyalty credit lines are already on the agreement, the base credit is multiplied by 2;

(b) when none is on it and the agreement was enrolled through the broker channel, the base credit is multiplied by 0.5;

(c) when none is on it and the agreement was enrolled by phone or web, the base credit is carried as it is.

The renewal loyalty credit lines are read from the agreement's bill lines, and the enrollment channel from the agreement record.

## Clause in table form

| Renewal loyalty credit lines already on the agreement | Enrollment channel of the agreement | Base credit as carried |
|---|---|---|
| One or more | Any | Base credit multiplied by 2 |
| None | Broker | Base credit multiplied by 0.5 |
| None | Phone or web | Base credit as it is |

## Illustrations (hypothetical base credit of $75.00)

- A Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas Fixed 24 agreement that already shows one renewal loyalty credit line from an earlier renewal carries $150.00.
- An agreement with no renewal loyalty credit line, enrolled through a broker, carries $37.50.
- An agreement with no renewal loyalty credit line, enrolled on the web, carries $75.00.
